page.overview:
Who is Ernie Azan?

Ernie Azan was a wizard who attended Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry during the 21st century.

Ernie was born at some point between 1990 and 1997, as he was attending Hogwarts during the same time as an unidentified Muggle-born Hogwarts student. Ernie thought of himself as a prankster and at some point demonstrated how to install a homemade Portable Swamp to an unidentified second-year witch. He was fearful of Filch and the other Professors, so he demonstrated the swamp on the lakeshore. However, his demonstration didn't go as planned, and the unidentified second-year witch suggested he stick with buying Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes products instead.
